$Comment: Harvest Moon, the nights around Halloween (October 28th to November 1st, both days in, UTC),
inside Hallow's Eve. The file name is the event id.
While it runs, CalendarSpawns/HallowsEvePack/Harvest_Moon_*.json rewrite the Hallow's Eve night
rules with higher weights and hand them back when it ends, and the geode and pumpkin finds roll
It is an event of its own with its own switch. The finds roll their extra only while Hallow's
Eve runs too, but the spawn rewrites ride Harvest Moon alone: a server owner who switches only
Hallow's Eve off in mods/ziggfreedcommon/calendar.json still gets the busier nights, so switch
both off, or every event at once with $Enabled.
Herald Start shows once to each player the first time they are on the server during the run;
End shows to everyone online when the run ends by its dates or by a command.
